explicit_non_claims: This note does not claim that a concrete four-manifold invariant has been established.
No concrete global Kirby-colour expansion instance has been constructed.
No source-bound graphical eight-case compiler has been constructed.
No concrete source-bound evaluator compiler instance has been constructed.
Handle-chain naturality is imported as one visible standard homology-domain axiom, not proved from serialized attaching maps.
The geometric semantics of presentation H2 certificates remain external to Lean.
The final H2 identity is derived in Lean and is not a field of either domain axiom.
Content hashes establish identity and freshness, not mathematical semantics.
This note does not identify the construction with Crane-Yetter or Yetter's state sum.
